82	        positive = {"success", "go", "pass", "mountain"}
83	        negative = {"failure", "kill", "no_go", "skip"}
84	        actual_l = actual.lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
85	        predicted_l = predicted.lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
